shared_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production-ready decorative illustration for Ottawa Visuals website. Match the style reference image: very thick rounded dark navy #0B2545 outlines, opaque white interiors, solid teal #00ABA9 shapes, restrained amber #E8A124 accents. Flat vector-like raster art, bold simple silhouettes, uniform heavy line weight, rounded joins. No gradients, shadows, texture, text, letters, numbers, labels, watermarks, logos, flags or party symbols. Genuine transparent background. Compact wide 2:1 composition, centred, 8% transparent safe margin; clear at 230px thumbnail width. Few strong overlapping forms. Qualitative imagery, no actual data or official emblems. Subject:

subjects.cityhall: A simple white municipal city hall building with a low teal roof and navy outlines behind the left edge of a large white council-agenda sheet. Sheet has two teal horizontal marks and one amber check mark. Small amber magnifying glass overlaps its lower right corner, conveying searching public council decisions. Municipal building must have a low rectangular civic silhouette, no parliamentary clock tower or classical temple. Balance building, agenda and magnifier as one concise symbol.
subjects.govcontracts: A large white public contract document with a folded teal corner and two teal horizontal entry marks. A simple teal briefcase with white handle overlaps its lower left edge; one small amber coin stack overlaps the lower right. Communicate federal consulting procurement and disclosed contracts. No checkmark, seals, dollar signs or parliamentary tower. Balance contract, briefcase and coins as one concise symbol.
